crime: When {WITCH_NAME} was little, the girl assigned to hold her hand let go at the school gate and wiped her palm on her skirt. "Your hand is all damp." From then on, every hand that took hers wiped itself after.

In the mansion, one girl sat on the upper railing every evening, calling down to the girls in the courtyard. "From up here, no one gets left out." Every evening she reached for {WITCH_NAME}'s hand, and every evening {WITCH_NAME} used her Magic and turned to mist.

One evening the girl's fingers swept through the mist. She laughed and wiped her wet palm on her skirt. "You're all dew." Then she swung round on the rail to catch her again and tipped outward, her hand closing in the mist as she cried {WITCH_NAME}'s name.
The prisoners in the courtyard looked up at the cry. They saw mist knitting into {WITCH_NAME}'s arm, thrust out over the rail, as the girl dropped. She landed on the path below and did not move.
In the trial court, the prisoners decided {WITCH_NAME} had turned to flesh to push her. The girl had cried out her killer's name.

Kneeling beside the girl on the path, she had seen the open palm, still wet with her own dew. Flesh in that grip would have held the girl. But as those fingers closed, {WITCH_NAME} had pulled her mist away from them, and gathered back into flesh only once they had slid through.
fields.epitaph: The only hand that never wiped her away was the one she let fall.
execution: The execution stand raises a giant iron hand, palm up, with her standing chained in it. A white cloth hangs from its wrist. One by one, the fingers close around her. The hand tightens into a fist and does not let go. When at last it opens over her, she does not move. The hand wipes its palm on the white cloth.

magic.name: Mist No Hand Can Hold
magic.text: She can melt into drifting mist and gather back into flesh at will.
